call-signs-13mar2025.csv.contentsIndicative: header 'Callsign,Product,Status,Type,LastModifiedDate,CreatedDate' (no BOM); 157,227 data rows. Status: 104,441 Allocated, 52,265 Reserved, 507 Available, 14 blank. Product (the licence class): 59,180 Full, 36,594 Foundation, 14,291 Intermediate, 1,901 Club, 112 Temporary Reciprocal, 45,149 blank. Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row (service discriminator, required-present but not carried). This export uniquely carries a CreatedDate column alongside LastModifiedDate; both run 2016-07-23 to 2025-03-13. Anomalies preserved verbatim: Excel date-mangled callsigns ('20-Dec', '21-Oct' and similar); over-length reciprocal forms up to twelve characters including 'M/TKG 2021' (an interior space); lower-case 'g0jrk' and '2e1GTD'; interior-space 'G6 FMU'; and 481 four-, 54 six-, 39 seven-, 54 eight-, 5 nine-, 3 ten-, 1 eleven- and 1 twelve-character callsigns.

normalised--call-signs-13mar2025.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date,created_date; 157,227 rows sorted by callsign. Status carried verbatim (Allocated/Reserved/Available and 14 blanks preserved); licence_class is the source Product verbatim (45,149 blanks preserved); last_modified_date and created_date ISO-rendered (day-first, verified by 70,402 and 104,297 day>12 values respectively). created_date is a registered extension column (record creation timestamp), distinct from last_modified_date. The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. The Excel date-mangled callsigns, over-length reciprocal 'M/TKG 2021', lower-case forms and interior-space 'G6 FMU' are preserved verbatim.
